en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a quiet cobblestoned town square with late‑19th/early‑20th‑century buildings. At right is a two‑storey house with shopfront signage and a balcony with flower boxes; behind it rises a church tower with clocks and a spire. On the left are several ornate townhouses with shops at street level. In the distance a larger civic-looking building stands at a bend in the street. The scene is devoid of cars and only a couple of pedestrians are visible.
